As more homeowners choose to stay in their homes and home equity levels remain near record highs, consumers are increasingly utilizing the value in their homes to fund renovations and other large ticket expenses, which we expect will continue in the current interest rate environment.
We adjust our selling and marketing expenditures dynamically in relation to anticipated revenue opportunities in order to ensure sufficient consumer inquiries to profitably meet such demand.
We will continue to adjust selling and marketing expenditures dynamically in response to anticipated revenue opportunities.

We continued to invest in internal development of new and enhanced features, functionality and business opportunities that we believe will enable us to better and more fully serve consumers and Network Partners.

We expect this environment to continue in 2026.

Jason Bengel, CFO, commented, "The company is on track to grow revenue and AEBITDA this year by 17% and 14%, respectively, at the midpoint of our updated forecast.

Our strong results continue to fortify our balance sheet, as we used excess cash to voluntarily repay $60 million of long-term debt during the quarter to improve free cashflow generation for shareholders going forward.
Given the strength of our balance sheet and what we view as attractive valuation of our equity, we intend to repurchase shares during the the fourth quarter for the first time since 1Q22."
